exampleEn: You need to follow through on your commitments to gain trust.
exampleKo: 신뢰를 얻으려면 당신의 약속을 끝까지 이행해야 합니다.
gameExamples: It's important to follow through with your plans if you want to achieve your goals.
She promised to help with the project, and I hope she will follow through.
If you say you'll do something, you should always follow through to show you mean it.
